threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: AI systems seizing further power — described as a hypothetical possibility ('might be able to seize further power if they attempted to'); no intention is explicitly attributed to the AI systems
threat_model.capability: AI systems 'would be more capable than humans in many domains'; they 'might be able to seize further power' if they attempted to, 'at least if they could coordinate'
threat_model.access: Widely embedded in phones, computers, TVs and cars; 'embedded in military and economic systems, among other places'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Seizing further power is conditional on attempt and coordination: 'if they attempted to, at least if they could coordinate'; outnumbering humans is conditional on widespread embedding: 'if they're widely embedded in phones, computers, TVs and cars'; the power-seizure possibility is premised on the prior state ('At this point... Given this') in which AI systems are 'more capable than humans in many domains, as well as more numerous' and 'embedded in military and economic systems'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Power — the 'further power' that AI systems might seize
